articles.title: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
articles.summary: A federal court in San Francisco has ruled that the Pentagon unlawfully classified Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The Department of Defense blacklisted the company in retaliation for its public criticism of government AI policy. The designation formally remains in place because a parallel case in Washington is still pending. The ruling still sends an important signal ahead of Anthropic's planned IPO this fall. articles.title: Nvidia Has Earnings Pricing Power, BlackRock's Li Says
articles.summary: BlackRock Global Chief Investment Strategist Wei Li says she is still optimistic about the artificial intelligence trade as investors await Nvidia's quarterly earnings report. "Scarcity sellers are doing quote a bit better than scarcity buyers and Nvidia is a scarcity seller," Li tells Bloomberg Television. "You look at some of the price increases that we have been talking about, and it really does show that they have earnings pricing power, earnings momentum," she adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Carbon Frames Don't Win Races: Why AI Doesn't Replace Infrastructure
articles.summary: AI can improve the customer experience, but it cannot fix broken financial infrastructure. In fintech, the real competitive advantage lies in the rails underneath: fast settlement, reliable payments, clean data, strong compliance, and systems built to handle real-world volume. As AI becomes table stakes, infrastructure is what will separate the winners from the companies with very expensive chat bubbles.Read All
